name: Arpst DebugSandbox — Diagnostics & Session Sandbox
author: ARPRO Studio

sections.description:
Forked from Health Check & Troubleshooting. Independently modernized and maintained by ARPRO Studio (https://arprostudio.com).

Arpst DebugSandbox — Diagnostics & Session Sandbox is a high-utility WordPress troubleshooting and diagnostics suite crafted by ARPRO Studio. It allows site owners, developers, and agencies to test plugin and theme conflicts, inspect live PHP/HTTP/Database/Mail logs, verify core file integrity, and export anonymized server blueprints inside a cryptographically isolated browser session—while regular website visitors continue to see your normal live site without interruption.

Provided “AS IS” under the GPLv2 license; always maintain regular site backups before performing site maintenance.

Key Capabilities Included in the Free Edition

  • 1. Browser-Isolated Session Sandbox & 100% Auto-Rollback:
    • Launches a private troubleshooting session bound to an HMAC-SHA256 signed cookie (arpst_diag_sandbox_token) in your browser.
    • Toggle plugins on or off (individually or via bulk actions on wp-admin/plugins.php), switch themes, or virtually delete plugins/themes inside your session while live visitors continue to see your untouched production configuration.
    • Full Content & Settings Isolation: Any test posts, pages, media attachments, comments, categories, navigation menus, or non-sensitive options created, edited, or trashed during your Sandbox session are isolated from live visitors and automatically rolled back to their pre-session state the moment you click Exit Sandbox.
  • 2. Real-Time Diagnostic Log Terminal & Unattended Flight Recorder:
    • Inspect and filter PHP Fatal Errors, Warnings, Notices, Deprecations, failed outbound HTTP API calls, failed wp_mail() dispatches, and SQL database errors in real time without needing FTP or SSH access.
    • Arm the Unattended Background Debug Flight Recorder in either 24-Hour Timed Mode or Continuous 5 MB Auto-Rotate Mode. All flight recorder logs are stored in a protected directory (wp-content/uploads/arpst-debugsandbox/) guarded by .htaccess, index.php, and a randomized filename hash.
  • 3. Official WordPress.org Core Checksum Scanner:
    • Verifies every core file in wp-admin/ and wp-includes/ against official WordPress.org MD5 checksums to detect modified, corrupted, or unexpected files in seconds.
  • 4. Outgoing wp_mail() Delivery & Latency Tester + Localhost Mail Catcher:
    • Send a branded HTML diagnostic email to verify PHPMailer delivery, custom From headers, and SMTP round-trip latency in milliseconds—complete with an automatic Localhost Mail Catcher for local development environments without an active SMTP server.
  • 5. .htaccess, Rewrite Rules & robots.txt Inspector + Anonymized Server Blueprint Exporter:
    • Inspect physical and virtual .htaccess and robots.txt rules, and export a 1-click Anonymized Server Blueprint in Markdown (for GitHub/WordPress.org support threads) or JSON (with domains, emails, IP addresses, and OS paths automatically stripped).
  • 6. 1-Click Legacy Health Check Migration & CVE-2025-64253 Cleanup:
    • Automatically imports preferences from abandoned Health Check installations and removes vulnerable legacy MU-plugin loaders.

Optional Arpst DebugSandbox Pro Companion (Separate Add-On)

All core Session Sandbox, Content & Option Auto-Rollback, Background Flight Recorder (both 24-Hour Timed and Continuous 5 MB Auto-Rotate modes), Core Checksum Scanner, wp_mail() Tester, and Anonymized Server Blueprint features are 100% included and unlocked in this free plugin.

Users who want automated 24/7 fatal crash recovery and team support links can optionally install the separate Arpst DebugSandbox Pro companion plugin available from ARPRO Studio, which adds:

  • 24/7 Early-Boot Fatal Crash Auto-Rollback Guard: Automatically detects unhandled PHP E_ERROR and E_PARSE crashes at the MU-Plugin boot stage and quarantines only the crashing plugin so your site recovers from White-Screen-of-Death lockouts automatically.
  • Shareable HMAC-Signed Magic Debug URLs: Generate time-limited (1-hour, 4-hour, or 24-hour) passwordless links that log an external support developer straight into an isolated Sandbox session without sharing your WP-Admin password.
  • Instant Multi-Channel Crash Alerts: Dispatches real-time fatal crash notifications via Branded HTML Email, Telegram Bot, Discord, or Slack webhooks.
  • Live Multi-Session Sandbox Monitor & Forensic .log Archives: Monitor all active Sandbox sessions in real time, terminate sessions remotely, and download 3-section forensic .log audit reports.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services only when an administrator explicitly triggers the corresponding diagnostic or support action in WP-Admin. It never tracks front-end visitors and never makes automatic background calls to external servers on page load.

  1. WordPress.org Core Checksums API (https://api.wordpress.org/core/checksums/1.0/)

    • What it is used for: Verifies local WordPress core files against official WordPress.org MD5 checksums in Tab 3 (“Integrity & Mail Tools”).
    • What data is sent and when: Sends your current WordPress version number and locale (e.g., en_US) only when an administrator clicks the “Run Official WordPress.org Checksum Scan Now” button.
    • Terms & Privacy: WordPress.org Privacy Policy.

  2. ARPRO Studio Feedback & Support Endpoint (https://arprostudio.com/wp-json/ar-license/v1/feedback)

    • What it is used for: Allows administrators to voluntarily send a feature suggestion or bug report directly to the developer from Tab 5 (“Roadmap & Feedback”).
    • What data is sent and when: Sent only when an administrator fills out the feedback form in Tab 5, ticks the explicit opt-in consent checkbox, and clicks submit. Transmits the submitted subject, message, reply-to email address, site URL, and (if the optional telemetry box is checked) basic WordPress/PHP/DB version strings.
    • Service Provider: ARPRO Studio (https://arprostudio.com).
    • Terms of Service: https://arprostudio.com/terms-of-service/
    • Privacy Policy: https://arprostudio.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. In your WordPress admin dashboard, navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Arpst DebugSandbox.
  3. Click Install Now, and then click Activate.
  4. Click Arpst Sandbox in the left-hand WP-Admin sidebar to open the dashboard.

Manual Installation via .zip Upload

  1. Download arpst-debugsandbox.zip from WordPress.org or arprostudio.com.
  2. In your WordPress admin dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin (or extract the arpst-debugsandbox folder to /wp-content/plugins/).
  3. Activate Arpst DebugSandbox — Diagnostics & Session Sandbox through the Plugins screen.
  4. Open Arpst Sandbox in the WP-Admin sidebar to launch an isolated troubleshooting session, inspect your logs, or run core integrity checks.
sections.faq:
Does Arpst DebugSandbox affect my live website visitors while I am troubleshooting?

No. The plugin binds your troubleshooting session to an HMAC-SHA256 signed cookie in your browser (arpst_diag_sandbox_token). Regular visitors without that cookie continue to see your normal active plugins, theme, and live content at all times.

What happens if I deactivate all plugins, change settings, or edit/trash a post while inside the Sandbox?

Everything done inside the Sandbox stays strictly isolated to your Sandbox session. Even if you select all plugins on wp-admin/plugins.php and click Deactivate, or modify site settings, or create/edit/trash test posts, pages, categories, or comments, live visitors never see those changes and 100% of your session changes are automatically rolled back the moment you click Exit Sandbox.

Where are diagnostic and flight recorder logs stored?

All diagnostic logs written by this plugin are stored inside a protected folder in your WordPress uploads directory (wp-content/uploads/arpst-debugsandbox/) guarded by .htaccess, index.php, and a randomized filename hash. Clearing the log inside a Sandbox session only clears your virtual session view and never erases your live log file on disk.

Does this plugin track front-end visitors or slow down my front end?

No. Arpst DebugSandbox contains zero front-end tracking scripts, analytics beacons, or advertisements, and adds zero overhead for normal website visitors.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial public release by ARPRO Studio (https://arprostudio.com).
  • Added HMAC-SHA256 browser-isolated Session Sandbox with full plugin, theme, content, taxonomy, comment, and in-session option virtualization & automatic rollback.
  • Added wp-admin/plugins.php bulk action interceptor and Sandbox host lock protection so bulk plugin deactivation inside a Sandbox never affects the live site.
  • Added 1-click legacy Health Check & Troubleshooting migrator and CVE-2025-64253 cleanup.
  • Added Real-Time Diagnostic Log Terminal and Unattended Background Debug Flight Recorder (24-Hour Timed and Continuous 5 MB Auto-Rotate modes in protected uploads directory).
  • Added WordPress.org Core File Integrity Checksum Scanner, wp_mail() delivery latency tester with Localhost Mail Catcher, .htaccess / robots.txt inspector, and 1-click Anonymized Server Blueprint Exporter (Markdown & JSON).
